experience.org: University of Winnipeg, Canada — Mitacs Globalink Research Intern

projects.name: Integrating Generative AI and Genomic Perturbation in Breast Cancer Radiogenomics
bullets: Developing conditional diffusion models and cGANs for multi-omics-conditioned image generation to map how individual genes influence tumor MRI characteristics.
Synthesizing medical images under single-gene-level perturbed omics conditions to uncover novel biomarkers and key molecular mechanisms driving imaging phenotypes like shape, texture, and intensity.

experience.org: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AIMS) Lab, FAST-NUCES — Research Assistant

projects.name: Detection of Physical Altercations or Atrocities in Public Places Using AI-Enabled Surveillance Systems
bullets: Designed a confidence-based experience replay paradigm for spatiotemporal 3D CNNs, mitigating catastrophic forgetting in sequential learning and retaining 82.5% accuracy across 5 continuous tasks.

Developed a memory-bounded rehearsal mechanism utilizing 512-dimensional feature-level storage, achieving a 588x reduction in memory footprint (to just 2.34 MB) to preserve decision-boundary integrity and enable edge deployment in resource-constrained systems.

Investigated model optimization interference through comprehensive ablation studies and t-SNE feature space analyses, demonstrating that uncertainty-driven sampling outperforms standard random sampling retention by over 13% in constrained environments.
Built scalable, cloud-based analytics solutions for multi-campus FAST-NUCES deployment featuring instantaneous threat alerting.

experience.org: UAV Dependability Lab, National Centre of Robotics and Automation (NCRA) — Research Assistant

projects.name: A Comprehensive Experimental Evaluation of Anomaly Detection Techniques in Aviation Cyber-Physical Systems
bullets: Conducted anomaly detection research for aviation cyber-physical systems to enhance UAV reliability and flight safety.
Evaluated deep learning architectures including Autoencoders, Temporal CNNs, and LSTMs on large-scale NASA aviation datasets for abnormal behavior detection.
Supervised undergraduate interns during Summer 2025, providing guidance on model experimentation, pipeline development, and interpretability.

projects.name: Q-DERMX: Hybrid Quantum-Classical AI for Medical Diagnostics (Blaise Pascal Quantum Challenge)
bullets: Built a hybrid classifier for the Blaise Pascal Global Quantum Challenge (France), integrating ResNet-18 with Parameterized Quantum Circuits (PQCs) via PennyLane to distinguish visually similar skin pathologies.

Applied Angle Embedding and Strongly Entangling Layers to project features into a high-dimensional Hilbert space, achieving 92.71% accuracy and resolving visual ambiguities between eczema and psoriasis.
Ranked among the Top 15 teams globally (out of 137).

projects.name: AI-Driven Retail Surveillance Analytics
bullets: Developed a computer vision system for detecting ice cream scoop theft and misconduct in retail environments using continuous video monitoring.
Built and annotated a custom CCTV dataset focused on human-object interaction patterns for supervised deep learning models.
Showcased the use of AI-driven surveillance analytics to improve transparency and accountability in small retail operations.

projects.desc: Engineered a hybrid Quantum-Classical AI diagnostic pipeline integrating ResNet-18 and Parameterized Quantum Circuits to classify visually similar skin pathologies with 92.71% accuracy.

projects.title: Continual Learning via RER-DNN for Real-Time Violence Detection
projects.desc: Built a scalable, real-time violence detection framework utilizing Continual Learning (RER-DNN), achieving 98% accuracy on the Bullying10K dataset for multi-campus deployment.

projects.title: Semantic Product Matching using Lightweight Transformers
projects.desc: Developed a semantic retrieval system (React, FastAPI, MongoDB) integrating the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 sentence transformer to generate dense vector embeddings for efficient similarity matching across e-commerce text datasets.

projects.title: Hybrid Transformer-CNN for Machine-Generated Text Detection
projects.desc: Created a high-performance hybrid neural network fusing DistilRoBERTa, Character-CNNs, and style features to detect machine-generated social media texts with 94.67% accuracy.
